map.：总帧数 = 帧率 × 时长(秒)，按四舍五入取整；换算比 ratio = 目标: : total frames = frame rate × duration (seconds), rounded; ratio = target frame rate / source frame rate. ratio>1 is frame interpolation (interpolate and slow playback by ratio×), ratio<1 is frame dropping (drop frames and speed playback by 1/ratio), equal needs no conversion.

map.为什么有 23.976 和 29.97 这种小数帧率？: Why are there fractional frame rates like 23.976 and 29.97?
map.源于 NTSC 彩色电视的实际场频（约 59.94Hz），为兼容而采用 23.9: They stem from NTSC colour TV's actual field frequency (about 59.94Hz), so 23.976/29.97 were adopted for compatibility. They differ from 24/30 by only 0.1%, but over long productions audio-video sync drift accumulates, so conversions must be explicit.
map.升帧能提升画质吗？: Does frame interpolation improve image quality?
map.不能增加真实信息。升帧靠插值生成中间帧，仅让运动更顺滑或实现慢动作；真实细节取决: It cannot add real information. Interpolation generates intermediate frames, only making motion smoother or enabling slow motion; true detail depends on the source's sampling frame rate.
